candidates.explanation: When createUserDto.provider is not set (as in AuthService.register, which passes only the register DTO), the provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google instead of AuthProvidersEnum.email. The new user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees user.provider !== email and throws 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register does not set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email when calling usersService.create. It relies on the default in UsersService.create, which is wrong.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email: `provider: createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email`. Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
